# Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript / React) – Patient Experience

**Company:** Verdane Care (FICTIONAL)
**Location:** Graz, Austria (hybrid) or fully remote within Austria, Germany, Croatia or Slovenia
**Employment:** Full-time, permanent (or B2B contract in Croatia on request)
**Team:** Patient Experience squad (4 engineers, 1 designer, 1 product manager)

## About the role

Verdane Care makes appointment-booking and follow-up software for private clinics and physiotherapy practices. Patients use our web app and mobile web experience to book visits, fill in intake forms, receive reminders and view exercise plans.

As a Full-Stack Engineer you will build and improve those patient-facing features end to end – from React components and accessibility to the Node.js APIs and the database behind them. You will work in a small squad with a designer and a product manager, and you will ship to production several times a week.

## What you will do

- Build new patient-facing features in React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and performance on low-end phones
- Implement Node.js (NestJS) APIs and PostgreSQL schemas to support those features
- Integrate with third-party systems such as clinic calendars, SMS providers and payment gateways
- Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests (Jest, Playwright) and keep the build green
- Take part in design reviews, usability sessions and sprint planning
- Handle personal health data responsibly: follow our GDPR and data-minimisation guidelines, support audit requests from clinic customers
- Mentor interns or junior colleagues when the opportunity arises

## What you bring

**Must have**
- 2+ years of professional experience building web applications with React and TypeScript
- Experience writing backend services in Node.js (Express, NestJS or similar) and working with SQL databases
- Understanding of semantic HTML, responsive layouts and web accessibility basics
- Experience with automated testing (unit and end-to-end) and Git-based workflows
- Awareness of web security fundamentals (authentication, OWASP Top 10) and willingness to learn the privacy requirements of health data
- Fluent English; German or Croatian is helpful for customer-facing conversations

**Nice to have**
- Experience with Next.js or other server-side rendering frameworks
- Experience in healthcare, wellness or other regulated environments
- Familiarity with AWS or a similar cloud, and with Docker
- Experience with design systems and Storybook
- Experience with analytics and A/B testing

## What we offer

- Salary range EUR 54,000 – 70,000 gross per year depending on experience (Austrian collective agreement minimum applies)
- 25 days of holiday plus the Austrian public holidays, 5 additional well-being days and a EUR 1,200 yearly education budget
- Flexible hours, a home-office stipend and a yearly team retreat
- A friendly, low-ego team that cares about the people who use our software

## How to apply

Send your CV. A short cover letter and a link to something you have built (a portfolio, a GitHub project or a live site) are welcome but optional. We reply within ten working days.

Verdane Care is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from career changers and people returning to work.

Its working environment connects product development with real clinical needs, including regular demos with clinic staff. The company’s focus on accessibility, privacy and making healthcare feel more human is central to its mission and culture.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring this practical, collaborative approach to Verdane Care as you build tools for clinics and their patients.

Thank you for considering my application. I’d be glad to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Patient Experience team.

Oskar Haddad-Lindqvist

Oskar Haddad-Lindqvist
oskar.hl@example.com | +46 70 555 0808

Dear Verdane Care Hiring Team,

I’m applying for the Full-Stack Engineer role on the Patient Experience team. I bring more than 10 years of professional web development experience, including building React and TypeScript applications alongside Node.js services and SQL databases. Verdane Care’s focus on patient-first, accessible software that makes healthcare interactions simpler is a strong match for the kind of end-to-end product work I do.

At Älvgrind Fintech, I develop onboarding features across React and TypeScript frontends and Node.js services in NestJS and Express, using PostgreSQL and AWS. I built a BankID identity-verification flow with QR-code handling, error states and retries; after testing and rollout, onboarding conversion improved from 61% to 74%. I also developed a document-upload workflow using S3 presigned URLs, malware scanning in Lambda, and SQS and PostgreSQL status tracking. This experience has given me practical exposure to identity verification and secure handling of sensitive user information, including BankID identity verification and ClamAV malware scanning, while my HTML, WCAG 2.1 AA audit fixes, and frontend development experience have strengthened my focus on accessible experiences.

I’m comfortable owning work from interface through backend and database, and I write unit and end-to-end tests with Jest and Playwright and use GitHub Actions in Git-based workflows. I’ve collaborated closely with designers in Figma, helped migrate legacy Express services to NestJS, and worked with feature flags and A/B testing. I have also mentored participants at a coding bootcamp, and I value helping others grow through practical, collaborative support. These experiences align well with your squad’s work across patient-facing features, APIs, usability and frequent production releases. I would welcome the opportunity to bring this practical, collaborative approach to Verdane Care as you build tools for clinics and their patients.

Thank you for considering my application. I’d be glad to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Patient Experience team.

Kind regards,
Oskar Haddad-Lindqvist

The progression from current experience to broader fit is logical and the tone fits the company’s patient-focused, collaborative culture. The main content limitation is that some relevant supporting evidence from the CV—especially Storybook, Next.js server-side rendering, and the regulated fintech/KYC context—is not fully surfaced.

The letter also aligns with the company’s focus on accessible, simple, patient-facing experiences and collaborative delivery. The candidate does not show healthcare or wellness experience, direct exposure to GDPR or health-data privacy requirements, OWASP Top 10 specifically, or evidence of semantic HTML and responsive-layout terminology.
